database_validation.name: PostgreSQL refresh-token concurrency
checks: simultaneous refresh produced one 200 and one 401
password change revoked prior access token
password change revoked prior refresh token

observations: Home showed the compact Help question-mark control.
Home tiles appeared in the requested order: Read Satcharita, My Groups, Live Darshan, Listen, Daily Programme, Upcoming Events, Naam Jaap.
The debug build displayed the emulator-only safety banner.
The unconfigured release build showed the expected missing-Firebase-project guidance instead of connecting to an emulator or cloud project.
browser_smoke.caveat: Requests aborted while immediately navigating away from Live and Events were browser-navigation cancellations, not console errors or failed assertions.

resolved_findings: Refresh tokens rotate once, replay is rejected, and password changes revoke prior access and refresh tokens.
Unsafe manual week values return a controlled 400 response.
Scheduling reports unfilled slots, validates hints, wraps round-robin slots, and saves the reviewed preview.
Chat cursor pagination is stable for tied timestamps and rejects missing or cross-group cursors.
Default CORS configuration restricts origins and remains configurable for deployment.
blocked_certification: Physical Android phone/tablet behavior, permissions, background audio, notification delivery, and accessibility services
Real Firebase project, production Auth providers, SMS, cloud Functions deployment, and production security configuration
PostgreSQL restore and full domain cascade/concurrent-write guarantees beyond the certified refresh-token path
Cross-browser web matrix and hosted SPA deep-link refresh
Human linguistic/OCR/source review for all 18 bundled languages
